phase: A: data integrity, training and two-train-night pilot only

data_rule_before_TM_download_or_parse.calendar: timestamps as supplied; no inferred timezone or DST conversion
data_rule_before_TM_download_or_parse.split: first 42 calendar dates starting at the earliest timestamp date, before completeness filtering; all later dates test
data_rule_before_TM_download_or_parse.complete_day: exactly one parseable finite nonnegative demand matrix at each of the 96 quarter-hour timestamps; same node IDs and admissible directed OD universe as native GEANT; absent OD entries are zero, invalid or duplicate OD IDs are corrupt
data_rule_before_TM_download_or_parse.eligible_night: complete calendar date plus all eight previous-day 22:00–23:45 matrices; no filtering on demand magnitude, costs, tie shares or model outputs
data_rule_before_TM_download_or_parse.test_access: download/parse/checksum/completeness/date labels only; no link loads, future decisions, simulated states, costs or outcomes
data_rule_before_TM_download_or_parse.daytime_for_capacity: 06:00–21:45 on retained train dates; 22:00–23:45 used for warmup
data_rule_before_TM_download_or_parse.consolidation: undirected physical links (both directions off); stable original increasing train-mean-night total bidirectional load order; skip bridges, stop at first connected removal exceeding 0.8 on any directed link; reroute only affected ODs by EV-TE min-hop/lexicographic rule

numerical_rule.time_unit: second; E4 fast kappa=1 per second, beta=0.3, no slow mode
numerical_rule.cost: sum of directed-link fluid backlog integrals; no energy term, c=0
numerical_rule.M0: conditional mean fast mode decays exp(-2*kappa*t); future baseline is train-only weekday/weekend slot-matched mean profile
numerical_rule.ties: exact equality; choose Stay, reuse E4 pick
numerical_rule.T_int: existing EV-TE estimate_tint/letter FFT first-zero estimator, separately per night/instance/configuration; zero variance reported as undefined, no invented h/T_int
numerical_rule.no_test_card: Claude will write card after Phase A report; no test runner launch here

planned.pilot_selection: earliest eligible weekday and earliest eligible weekend train dates; else first two retained train dates

limitations_to_report: Daytime interpretation, clock timezone and fast-unit seconds are explicit implementation conventions where brief supplies no further definition.
T_int on a finite nonstationary six-hour night is descriptive, not a stationary network mixing-time certificate.
Pilot CPU extrapolation on local hardware is not measured n2-standard-32 performance.

precomputation_clarifications.reason: First archive file inspected for parser schema has 441 sparse demands, native topology has 462 ODs. Omitted OD entries encode no demand, not a corrupt/missing TM. Reindex to the native directed OD universe with zero fill; retain presence mask for lossless round trip.
precomputation_clarifications.exposure: one archive member schema only; no test outcomes or load aggregates
precomputation_clarifications.time: before full archive parsing and training
